Ventureneer specializes in defining and eliminating problems that hold underrepresented entrepreneurs back through research, training, and content. 

Our research raises awareness of the trends and greater challenges women and minorities entrepreneurs face. We produced The Wells Fargo Impact of Women-Owned Business and The Impact of

Geri Stengel, Ventureneer's president, is best known for writing in Forbes about the success factors of women entrepreneurs and a Substack newsletter -- Women's Health & Market Visibility.

rows.business_description:
Fun and Function is dedicated to empowering people to reach their full potential and participate in the world around them.  Improving the lives of kids with special needs is our driving mission. We create therapeutic tools, educational programs, and multi-sensory environments to support behavioral and developmental goals, address learning and sensory challenges, and social-emotional needs.
We design, innovate and iterate with our experienced team of occupational therapists, research scientists, educators and product developers, drawing feedback and inspiration from communities across the globe. Our collective experience spans the worlds of academia, health and medicine, education, and business. Our initiatives shape public and private spaces including airports, therapy clinics, military bases, churches, malls, schools, hospitals and homes. 
Aviva Weiss, MS OTR/L, is the co-founder and CEO of Fun and Function, the award-winning company dedicated to realizing each child's fullest potential. This inspiring vision for Fun and Function was born out of frustration: Aviva and her husband Haskel couldn't find kid-friendly sensory tools for their family's special needs and decided to create their own to help every family. 
Over the past 15 years, Aviva has successfully expanded the product offering and environmental solutions for home, school and travel, supporting the diverse needs of people of every age. Aviva is sought-after for her expertise in creating inclusive environments and for collaborating with schools nationwide to implement The Active Mind School Partnership
Prior to launching Fun and Function, Aviva Weiss worked at leading institutions including Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia and St. Christopher’s Hospital.  She serves on the advisory board of Salus University's Occupational Therapy Program, and mentors occupational therapy students and entrepreneurs. Aviva thrives on the challenges of running a business, and loves being the mom of eight wonderful children.
